learner_starting_state: Has an all-objective evidence ledger and complete remediation routes for every unresolved objective.
learner_ending_state: Can design and defend an offline capstone integrating Foundry client, text/speech, and Content Understanding patterns and can issue a cautious evidence-based readiness recommendation.
mastery_gate: Score 12 of 12 on primary and fresh-transfer capstone forms, pass all three implementation boundaries and three readiness/safety boundaries, and meet prerequisite evidence gates; the result is a recommendation, never an exam guarantee.

provenance_policy.citation_expectation: The AI-901 study guide controls objective scope; current Foundry SDK, Language, Speech, and Content Understanding claims cite official Microsoft sources.
provenance_policy.unsupported_claim_behavior: Reverify exam objectives/weights, portal labels, SDK/APIs, analyzer schemas, models, capabilities, regions, prices, previews, and deprecations before a final recommendation.

notes: Offline capstone design only; no media or data is processed, no service is called, and no exam outcome or live action is guaranteed or authorized.
